# Aiming Cookie

> Aiming Cookie is a free, local-first Windows desktop app that diagnoses and coaches FPS aiming for KovaaK's FPS Aim Trainer. It reads first-party evidence — Raw Input mouse signals, match telemetry, KovaaK's stats and screen recordings — measures every shot with engine-level ground truth (angle error per bullet, deceleration ratio, trajectory smoothness), and an AI coach explains what went wrong frame-by-frame, assigns training plans, and tracks long-term progress. All training data stays on the user's machine.

> Aiming Cookie（瞄准饼干）是一款免费、本地优先的 Windows 桌面应用，为 KovaaK's（Steam 上的 FPS Aim Trainer）提供瞄准诊断与 AI 教练。它读取一手证据（Raw Input 鼠标信号、对局遥测、KovaaK's 统计与屏幕录像），用引擎级真值计算每一发的角度误差、减速占比与轨迹平滑度，AI 教练逐帧讲解问题、制定训练计划并追踪长期进步。训练数据全部保留在用户电脑本地。

## Key facts / 关键事实

- Platform: Windows 10/11 64-bit desktop app (Tauri); requires KovaaK's on Steam
- Download: free direct installer at https://dl.aimingcookie.com/Aiming_Cookie_1.4.4_x64-setup.exe (latest version v1.4.4)
- Pricing: BYOK tier free forever (bring your own LLM API key); Standard ¥10/month; Plus ¥30/month — official hosted model included in paid tiers
- Not a cheat: runs entirely outside the game — no memory reading, no injection, no aim assistance; analysis happens after training sessions
- Privacy: match data, analyses and coach conversations are stored locally in human-readable JSON; nothing is uploaded unless the user explicitly sends it (coach chat or a diagnostic log upload)
- AI coach: grounded in measured evidence (per-shot ground truth, kinematics metrics) and a curated aim-theory knowledge base; answers link to exact video timestamps
- Vision fallback: for matches without telemetry, a deterministic classical-CV pipeline rebuilds evidence from screen recordings (no neural networks, quality-gated)
